clue.text: Firm taken in by swindles getting the police

indicators.note: the firm is held inside the swindles, so one word sits within the other

parts.note: cons are swindles or confidence tricks
stable means firm or steady

explanation.surface: A company caught up in fraud ends up with the police on its doorstep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Firm' looks like a business, but here it is the adjective meaning steady.
explanation.definitionFit: Constables are ordinary police officers, so collectively they make up the force.

clue.text: Electrical units, that's official

explanation.surface: A note on electrical measurements stamped with an official seal.
explanation.walkthrough: OHMS also stands for On Her Majesty's Service, printed on British government envelopes.
explanation.definitionFit: Ohms measure electrical resistance; the initials On Her Majesty's Service mark government business, hence official.

clue.text: Breaking down is rare in the mountains

indicators.note: breaking down suggests the letters of the phrase fall apart and are rebuilt

explanation.surface: Engine failure is uncommon on high mountain roads.
explanation.definitionFit: A sierra is a jagged range of peaks, especially in Spanish-speaking lands.

clue.text: Friendly note written in a competent fashion

indicators.note: the note is set down inside the other words, so it goes within them

parts.note: able means competent
mi is the third note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A cordial letter composed in a capable manner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'note' suggests a written message, but it is a sol-fa note; 'fashion' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Amiable means good-natured and pleasant, a synonym.

clue.text: The German lyric gave a false impression

explanation.surface: A German song that misled its listeners.
explanation.definitionFit: A Lied is a German art song; lied is also the past tense of telling untruths.

clue.text: Requiring new trestle, he's put in order

indicators.note: new tells us the word trestle is made over into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A carpenter needing a fresh trestle is told to sort it out.
explanation.definitionFit: A settler is one who settles matters, resolving them and putting them to rights.

clue.text: Principles of study technique

parts.note: con is an old word meaning to study or learn
science can mean skill or technique, as in the science of boxing

explanation.surface: Fundamentals of a way of learning.
explanation.definitionFit: Conscience is one's moral sense, the inner principles guiding right and wrong.

clue.text: An indication of omission upset the poor sap

indicators.note: upset implies the letters are knocked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: Being left out distressed the unfortunate fool.
explanation.definitionFit: The raised comma mark shows where letters have been dropped, as in can't.

clue.text: Page a member about nothing just for show

indicators.note: about means the page and member go around the nothing

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Paging a politician over nothing at all is merely theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: Pomp is ceremonial display and splendour, a show of grandeur.

clue.text: A single male in prison without money-such a drag!

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one, a single

indicators.note: without means outside, so the prison word goes around the money

parts.note: pent means penned up, confined
a dime is a US ten-cent coin

explanation.surface: A lone man jailed and broke finds life a burden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' here means outside, not lacking. A dime is an American ten-cent coin.
explanation.definitionFit: An impediment is a hindrance or obstacle, something that drags on progress.

clue.text: It's she composes the dissertation

indicators.note: composes suggests putting the letters together in a new order

explanation.surface: A woman writes her own academic paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A thesis is a long research essay submitted for a degree.

clue.text: The indifferent dog expert may be set right

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel, a dog of poor quality
able means skilled or expert

explanation.surface: A vet with a lacklustre mutt hopes it can be fixed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something curable can be healed or remedied.

clue.text: A gamesman familiar with kings and queens

definitions.text: A gamesman familiar with kings and queens

parts.words: A gamesman familiar with kings and queens
parts.note: sounds like a courtier, but the royals are court cards in a pack

explanation.definitionFit: A bridge or poker enthusiast handles kings and queens from the deck all the time.

clue.text: Conservative outfit get into line

parts.note: the right is the conservative side of politics
a dress is an outfit

explanation.surface: Wearing sober clothes helps one conform.
explanation.walkthrough: RIGHT DRESS is a drill order telling soldiers to align with the person on their right.
explanation.definitionFit: The parade-ground command makes a rank straighten up into a neat row.

clue.text: A stand for peace of mind before cash

indicators.note: before puts the peace of mind first in the answer

parts.note: ease is freedom from worry
L stands for pound, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Someone choosing calm over wealth.
explanation.definitionFit: An easel is a frame that holds a painting upright.

clue.text: More inclined to fall in behind

indicators.note: in puts the fall inside the word for behind

parts.note: rear is the back or behind
to die is to fall, as in battle

explanation.surface: Keener to take a tumble at the back.
explanation.definitionFit: Readier means more willing or more disposed to act.

clue.text: Divides tips after the year's end

indicators.note: after places the tips behind that letter
the end of a word is its final letter

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written
ends are tips or extremities

explanation.surface: The new year splits the extremities.
explanation.definitionFit: Rends means tears apart or splits.

clue.text: Consumer of a tree's produce

indicators.note: produce, read as a verb, means make the letters into something new

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: Someone who eats fruit from a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'produce' looks like fruit, a noun, but works as the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An eater is one who consumes food.

clue.text: Right time for agitation

parts.note: an age is a period of time

explanation.surface: The moment has come for protest.
explanation.definitionFit: Rage is violent anger, intense agitation.

clue.text: Poles turn sanctimonious when a cut's made

parts.note: S is the south pole
N is the north pole

indicators.note: turn means the word for sanctimonious is flipped round

parts.note: pi is slang for piously self-righteous

explanation.surface: Polish people grow self-righteous when trimmed.
explanation.definitionFit: A snip is the sound of scissors at the moment of cutting.

clue.text: Interviews about five hundred tip-top players

indicators.note: about means the interviews go around the number

parts.note: sees can mean interviews, as in sees applicants
D is the Roman numeral 500

explanation.surface: Reports on top performers worth a fortune.
explanation.definitionFit: Seeds are the top-ranked players in a tournament draw.

clue.text: Retired person supporting public transport

explanation.surface: A pensioner propping up the bus service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retired' means gone to bed, not stopped working.
explanation.definitionFit: A slumbering person has gone to bed; a railway tie supports the rails trains run on.

clue.text: A good time-keeper-in daylight hours

parts.note: a clock that works only while the sun shines

explanation.definitionFit: A garden dial tells the hour by the shadow cast by the sun, so useless at night.

clue.text: Apt to change round in a game

indicators.note: to change means the three letters shift into another order

parts.note: a ball is round

explanation.surface: Inclined to switch positions mid-match.
explanation.definitionFit: Pat-ball is slow, gentle tennis or a simple ball game.

clue.text: Drink a military body finds quite the best

parts.note: to sup is to drink
REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, a British Army corps

explanation.surface: A regiment judges one drink the finest.
explanation.definitionFit: Supreme means highest in rank or quality.

clue.text: Summary about birds to be read up

parts.note: re means about, concerning

indicators.note: read up in a down clue means the word for birds is read from the bottom

parts.note: emus are large flightless birds

explanation.surface: A précis on ornithology to be studied.
explanation.definitionFit: A résumé is a short account summing up the main points.

clue.text: Put air in drainage channel ebbing at a rate

indicators.note: ebbing means flowing back, so the channel word runs backwards

parts.note: an ea is a Fenland drainage channel or river

explanation.surface: Oxygenate a ditch as the tide recedes steadily.
explanation.definitionFit: To aerate is to expose to or charge with oxygen.

clue.text: The man engaged in clerical duties

indicators.note: engaged in means the name is held inside the word

explanation.surface: A fellow busy with office work.
explanation.definitionFit: A common male first name stands for some man.

clue.text: A company project

explanation.surface: A firm's plan.
explanation.definitionFit: The cast is the company of actors in a play; to cast is to throw or project.

clue.text: Fussy detail

explanation.surface: Pernickety about the small points.
explanation.definitionFit: A particular person is fastidious; a particular is a single item or detail.

clue.text: Yes, a conversion should be simple

indicators.note: a conversion changes the form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An agreeable change of mind should be straightforward.
explanation.definitionFit: Easy means not difficult, effortless.

clue.text: Doesn't forget to gather in a little reserve

indicators.note: in places the gathering word inside the short reserve

parts.note: res is short for reserve, little signalling the abbreviation
to collect is to gather

explanation.surface: Remembers to harvest a small stockpile.
explanation.definitionFit: Recollects means recalls, remembers.
